# scutum_federation_peer (Resource)

Link a federated Scutum hub so that the two WireGuard meshes can route to each other.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scutum_federation_peer" "dr_site" {
  name          = "dr-site"
  hub_url       = "https://scutum-dr.example.com"
  wg_endpoint   = "203.0.113.50:51820"
  wg_public_key = "DrHubPubKey+AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA="
  mesh_cidr     = "10.200.0.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hub_url` (String) API URL of the remote Scutum hub.
- `mesh_cidr` (String) CIDR block of the remote hub's mesh.
- `name` (String) Human-readable peer name.
- `wg_endpoint` (String) WireGuard UDP endpoint of the remote hub (host:port).
- `wg_public_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the remote hub.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (String) Extra CIDRs to route via this peer (comma-separated).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
